Checkpoint monotherapy excluded (MSS, TMB 8.6); only credible immunotherapy route is KRAS-inhibitor FAS/CD8 reprogramming (PMID 37625401), which favors the small molecules. ECOG 1 assumed. No abstain. Humanizer pass applied to prose fields.

Round 1 conservative position. No FDA-approved targeted agent exists on the feature axis, so ranked by depth of characterized safety rather than effect size. daraxonrasib #1: only randomized phase 3 (RASolute 302 n=500) toxicity dataset on the board, G>=3 TRAE 43.6% vs chemo 57.5%, TRAE discontinuation 1.2%, predictable dermatologic AEs with established management algorithms. zoldonrasib #2: cleanest tolerability (no G4/5, mostly G1-2 GI) but only n=40 single-arm phase 1, safety base thin. incb161734 #3: strongest single-agent ORR but DAWN-303 chemo combination carries G>=3 neutropenia ~40% not characterized in a dedicated combination trial. ceralasertib #4: ARID1A second axis but per-term G>=3 cytopenias unreported in the abstract (named missing safety datum), no PDAC responder, entry gated on BAF250a IHC. preferences.json toxicity_vetoes empty so no round-1 veto issued. KRAS vaccines (ELI-002 safest by AE profile, zero G>=3) not ranked: adjuvant/MRD-only, do not fit metastatic disease. HLA-C*08:02 TCR-T/NT-112 allele-mismatched (patient C*05:01/C*06:02). Checkpoint monotherapy off (MSS, TMB 8.6); MMR IHC is the validation gate. ASXL1 plasma frameshift flagged for CHIP. ECOG 1 assumed. No abstain. Humanizer pass applied to prose fields.

Round 1 critic position, ranked by evidence grade. daraxonrasib #1: only RCT on the board (RASolute 302, n=500, registered OS endpoint HR 0.40, 95% CI 0.30-0.53, p=4.6e-11, RoB2 Some); caveats are open-label PFS/ORR bias, 2L->1L line extrapolation (RASolute 303 unread), and G12D borrowed from a RAS G12 subgroup not a pre-specified per-allele analysis. zoldonrasib #2 and incb161734 #3: uncontrolled n=40/n=41 phase 1 abstracts, ORR 30%/37% without CI and without mature PFS/DoR; numerically different ORRs treated as within-noise, not as evidence one beats the other. ceralasertib #4 (weakest): confirmed ORR 14% (4/29) overall, the 31% is a post-hoc gynecologic subgroup with zero PDAC responders, cross-tumor extrapolation, entry gated on BAF250a IHC the frameshift does not confirm. No immunotherapy ranked: ELI-002/Hopkins nivo-ipi efficacy split by on-treatment immune response not randomization (ROBINS-I Serious) and adjuvant-only; C*08:02 TCR-T/NT-112 allele-mismatched (C*05:01/C*06:02). Checkpoint monotherapy off (MSS, TMB 8.6); MMR IHC is the gate; ASXL1 plasma frameshift to paired blood-cell CHIP confirmation. Provisional RoB flag: the three abstract-stage reads (zoldonrasib, incb161734, ceralasertib) lack full per-trial bias profiles. No abstain (one genuine RCT exists). ECOG 1 assumed. Humanizer pass applied to prose fields.
